messages:
talia-g: follow-up from the postmortem: auth token throttle from vendor + incidental cloud maintenance caused model-registry write timeouts and a deployment backlog. we sketched fixes in the doc but need concrete owners and deadlines. posting a compact action list — please reply with owner + ETA.

samir-d: quick recap: incident kicked off ~01:12 UTC when vendor started maintenance; token error rate spiked ~12% -> registry writes hit 503s -> retries piled up. read-only reads stayed healthy.

oncall-rob: live notes: stopped retries to protect DB; created temporary apply-queue and drained it over an hour. locking down runbook changes next.

talia-g: proposed actions (reply with owner + ETA):
- vendor SLA + maintenance calendar ask (formal escalation) -> owner: contracts-lee -> ETA: 10d
- dual-token-provider failover design + probe (hot swap on health fail) -> owner: samir-d -> ETA: 3w
- lightweight local write-queue + background apply (best-effort, idempotent) -> owner: samir-d -> ETA: 2w
- SDK: retry/backoff + cached-token read-only mode -> owner: samir-d -> ETA: 7d
- new alert: token error rate >4% for 5m + registry write-failure spike -> owner: oncall-rob -> ETA: 48h
- deploy pipeline gate to throttle large batch deploys during provider maintenance -> owner: oncall-rob -> ETA: EOW
- customer comms template for vendor-caused degradations -> owner: contracts-lee -> ETA: 1w

contracts-lee: taking vendor escalation + comms template. will ping account team and ask for an advanced maintenance window calendar. ETA 10d for contract clarity, comms template in 5d.

samir-d: I'll own the failover + SDK + queue. SDK retry PR planned for tomorrow, queue prototype in 1w, failover plan doc by EOW and initial probe implementation in 3w. I'll link everything to INC-7001.

oncall-rob: will add alert rule and pipeline gate. alerting rule and dashboard tiles tonight, gate config by Friday. also will add a recurring monthly auth-dependency review.

ops-bot: created INC-7001 - "auth-dep resilience: failover, queue, alerts" assigned to samir-d, oncall-rob, contracts-lee. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-7001

talia-g: two prioritization notes: 1) make multi-provider failover P0 given recurrence; 2) queue + SDK changes are P1 but should land quickly to reduce blast radius. if no objections I'll bump INC-7001 to P0 and ask product to re-evaluate roadmap.

samir-d: agree re: P0. will prioritize failover probe work and post a timeline into INC-7001.

contracts-lee: ack. I'm escalating the calendar ask to the vendor today.

oncall-rob: ack. scheduling a 15m sync Mon 09:00 to review blockers. update INC-7001 if you reassign. :thumbsup:
